title: Unctuous Malaysian Lardons Curry
description: A rich and creamy Malaysian curry featuring lardons and vegetable shortening, perfect for a comforting meal. This dish is made with raw-friendly ingredients and served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Heat the vegetable shortening in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lardons and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the potatoes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the potatoes are tender.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Transfer the curry to a lacquerware bowl and serve immediately.
